outputs.name: Representative side-view scout, single idle pose

contract.intent: [1 lighting; observed from reference.png and reference-b.png (i_lighting, s_refobs)] Flat colour: no directional light, no shading ramps. [2 design language; PIXL proposal awaiting owner agreement (i_design_language)] Carry the references' flat colour, absent anti-aliasing, binary alpha and blocky low-detail construction into a genuinely side-view figure; the references' front-facing symmetric shape is a style swatch, not the character design. [3 outline; controlled-evaluation sample confirmation (i_outline, sources/controlled-evaluation-answers.md): sample only, not an owner preference, not family or production policy] Outlined as reference.png: a flat #25354A contour at the weight shown there (2 logical px) fully enclosing the figure and also carrying the shoulder bar, base bar and solid top stalks, adapted to the side view; the no-outline treatment of reference-b.png stays open for the family. [4 identity landmarks for the readability criterion; PIXL construction proposal under component 2, not an owner requirement] (a) two top stalks separated by a notch, solid in the contour colour; (b) cream eye placement adapted to profile so the figure has an unambiguous facing direction; (c) the navy shoulder bar; (d) the navy base bar; (e) the enclosing navy contour separating the figure from the background. The single idle pose faces right, a scoped specialist choice for the sample that the engine can mirror.
